jev.noul_contract: Returns the probability of yes; optional true/false criteria descriptions supported.
jev.price_basis: Published provider list rates, not account invoice. Current models documentation and September15 launch announcement both confirm input rate and free output.

documented_rate_limits.qualification: Provider explicitly says limits can change without notice.

compatibility_conclusions: Pinned jev-1.13.0 is the currently documented Jev release and uses the configured /v1/systemone endpoint.
Frozen completion checks use supported noul questions, text instructions and true/false criteria. Threshold0.8 is applied by existing Proceda runtime.

reason_for_user_directed_switch.summary: Installed Laya silently cropped both frozen completion question heads before inference; this loss is not represented by state_truncated. Input to the checker was compromised even if the state fit. User subsequently requested hosted Jev while preserving Qwen and threshold0.8.

qwen.rate_evidence: Verified official Nebius public endpoint modal through browser UI; prices explicitly approximate, actual cost depends on usage.
